headline: US Treasury Refunding Outlook Steadies as Borrowing Pressures Persist
summary: Market participants evaluated the US Treasury Department's latest quarterly refunding statement as neutral, while analysts noted that divided government may limit deficit expansion.
why: The US Treasury's quarterly refunding schedule determines auction sizes across maturities, directly impacting sovereign bond yields and borrowing costs worldwide.

impacts.name: US 10-Year Treasury Yield
impacts.why: Refunding issuance plans were largely neutral, leaving bond yields balanced between deficit worries and steady supply.
